issue: My computer is not turning on. The power light is not illuminating.
solution_criteria: Quickly diagnose and resolve the power issue. Solution must restore the user's ability to access their computer within 30 minutes.

issue: I am unable to access the company's internal file server. I need to retrieve an important document for a meeting in 2 hours.
solution_criteria: Investigate and restore the user's access to the file server. Solution must be provided within 1 hour to ensure the user can retrieve the necessary document.

issue: My printer is not responding when I try to print a document. I have a deadline to submit this report by the end of the day.
solution_criteria: Troubleshoot and resolve the printer issue. Solution must be provided within 2 hours to allow the user to print the document before the end of the day.
